doc_title: Tamberlow Capital Partners III, L.P. Limited Partnership Agreement, original and Amended and Restated
notes: Investment Limitations moves verbatim from 2.4 to 5.6 and its old number is reused by the new Subscription Credit Facility section, so alignment by number produces a false modification or a false add/remove pair; the only trace of the move elsewhere is a non-material cross-reference update in 5.2. Most material edits are single-token or single-clause changes inside long paragraphs (1.50% to 1.25%, may to shall, 90 to 120 days, an Advisory Committee approval becoming General Partner self-approval, a one-clause indemnification carve-out), interleaved with five non-material text edits and ten byte-identical sections.

changes.description: Typo corrected from "principle office" to "principal office"; the address and purpose are unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: its principle office is at 212 Lowry Crest Avenue, Suite 600, Minneapolis, Minnesota 55401
changes.current_quote: its principal office is at 212 Lowry Crest Avenue, Suite 600, Minneapolis, Minnesota 55401

changes.description: Record date of the Schedule of Partners rolled forward from April 7, 2025 to January 26, 2026; the closing period, hard cap, 8% interest and 2% GP commitment are unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: maintained by the General Partner and updated through April 7, 2025
changes.current_quote: maintained by the General Partner and updated through January 26, 2026

changes.description: Defined term "Drawdown Notice" renamed "Capital Call Notice" at both uses; the ten Business Day notice period, required contents and post-Commitment Period limits are unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: by written notice (a "Drawdown Notice") delivered at least ten Business Days before the due date. Each Drawdown Notice shall state
changes.current_quote: by written notice (a "Capital Call Notice") delivered at least ten Business Days before the due date. Each Capital Call Notice shall state

changes.description: Investment Limitations relocated verbatim from Article II (Section 2.4) to Article V (Section 5.6); the 20% single-company and 25% non-North America limits and all other text are unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: Without the consent of the Advisory Committee, the Partnership shall not (a) invest more than 20% of aggregate Commitments in any single Portfolio Company and its Affiliates
changes.current_quote: Without the consent of the Advisory Committee, the Partnership shall not (a) invest more than 20% of aggregate Commitments in any single Portfolio Company and its Affiliates

changes.description: New section authorizes subscription-line borrowing secured by Unfunded Commitments, capped at the lesser of 25% of aggregate Commitments and aggregate Unfunded Commitments with each borrowing repaid within 364 days, requires LP lender confirmations, runs the preferred return from the borrowing date and requires IRR reporting with and without the facility.
changes.current_quote: borrowings outstanding under all Subscription Facilities shall not exceed the lesser of 25% of aggregate Commitments and aggregate Unfunded Commitments, and (b) each borrowing shall be repaid within 364 days

changes.description: General Partner catch-up in clause (c) changed from 100% to the General Partner to 80% to the General Partner and 20% to the Limited Partner, still until the General Partner has received 20%; the 8% preferred return and final 80/20 split are unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: (c) third, 100% to the General Partner until the General Partner has received 20% of the aggregate amounts distributed under clause (b) and this clause (c)
changes.current_quote: (c) third, 80% to the General Partner and 20% to the Limited Partner until the General Partner has received 20% of the aggregate amounts distributed under clause (b) and this clause (c)

changes.description: Tax Distributions section deleted, eliminating the General Partner's authority to make annual tax distributions at the Assumed Tax Rate (New York, New York individual rate) as advances against Section 3.1 distributions.
changes.prior_quote: the General Partner may cause the Partnership to distribute to each Partner, within 90 days after each fiscal year, the amount by which the net taxable income allocated to it for that year multiplied by the Assumed Tax Rate exceeds its distributions under Section 3.1 for that year

changes.description: Post-Commitment Period Management Fee rate reduced from 1.50% to 1.25% of Net Invested Capital; the 2.00% of Commitments rate during the Commitment Period is unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: (b) thereafter, 1.50% of the Net Invested Capital attributable to those Limited Partners on the first day of the quarter
changes.current_quote: (b) thereafter, 1.25% of the Net Invested Capital attributable to those Limited Partners on the first day of the quarter

changes.description: Carry-forward and refund sentence for excess fee offsets reworded with identical meaning; the 100% offset and the operating adviser exclusion are unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: Any reduction in excess of the Management Fee for a quarter shall be carried forward and, to the extent not applied by dissolution, refunded to the Limited Partners.
changes.current_quote: To the extent the reduction for a quarter exceeds the Management Fee for that quarter, the excess shall be carried forward, and any excess not applied by dissolution shall be refunded to the Limited Partners.

changes.description: Added sentence makes the Partnership bear its allocable share of the regulatory compliance costs of the Manager and the General Partner (Form PF and Form ADV filings, regulatory examinations), which were not a Partnership Expense before; the $2,000,000 organizational expense cap is unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: litigation and indemnification expenses; and winding-up expenses. The Manager shall bear its own ordinary overhead
changes.current_quote: Partnership Expenses also include the allocable share of the Partnership in the regulatory compliance costs of the Manager and the General Partner, including Form PF and Form ADV filings and responses to regulatory examinations.

changes.description: Cross-reference to the investment limitations renumbered from Section 2.4 to Section 5.6 to follow the relocated section; the Advisory Committee's role is unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: waivers of the investment limitations in Section 2.4
changes.current_quote: waivers of the investment limitations in Section 5.6

changes.description: Approval of Affiliated Transactions moved from prior approval by the Advisory Committee to advance approval by the General Partner as fair and reasonable, with only written notice to the Advisory Committee.
changes.prior_quote: unless the Affiliated Transaction has been approved in advance by the Advisory Committee.
changes.current_quote: unless the Affiliated Transaction has been approved in advance by the General Partner as fair and reasonable to the Partnership, with written notice to the Advisory Committee.

changes.description: Suspension of the Commitment Period on a Key Person Event changed from discretionary ("may suspend") to mandatory ("shall suspend"); the two-of-three trigger and 180 day cure are unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: Upon a Key Person Event, the General Partner may suspend the Commitment Period
changes.current_quote: Upon a Key Person Event, the General Partner shall suspend the Commitment Period

changes.description: New section permits sales of Investments to a Manager-affiliated Continuation Vehicle only with prior Advisory Committee approval, a competitive process supported by a fairness opinion, and a cash-or-roll election for each Limited Partner on at least 20 Business Days' notice, with fee disclosure and expenses borne by the vehicle.
changes.current_quote: each Limited Partner may elect, on at least 20 Business Days' notice, to receive its share of the proceeds in cash or to roll its interest into the Continuation Vehicle on the same economic terms

changes.description: Carve-out added to the exclusion for proceedings a Covered Person initiates against the Partnership or another Covered Person, so proceedings a Covered Person brings to enforce its rights under Section 6.1 (exculpation and indemnification) are now indemnified.
changes.prior_quote: Indemnification shall not extend to any proceeding initiated by a Covered Person against the Partnership or another Covered Person. No Partner
changes.current_quote: Indemnification shall not extend to any proceeding initiated by a Covered Person against the Partnership or another Covered Person, other than a proceeding to enforce its rights under this Section 6.1.

changes.description: Deadline for delivering annual audited financial statements extended from 90 days to 120 days after fiscal year end; the 60 day quarterly reporting deadline is unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: (a) within 90 days after the end of each fiscal year, audited financial statements of the Partnership
changes.current_quote: (a) within 120 days after the end of each fiscal year, audited financial statements of the Partnership
